whatItFakes: With fast-forward on (development only), candidates take no campaign turns and volunteers walk no doors, so a race is decided by the voters' leans, parties, the incumbent's record and the impressions earlier days left.
why: The owner asked for 20 years in seconds, accepted if the result makes sense in the end (Nov 8, 1:58 a.m.); a campaign's town halls, speeches and doors are most of an election year's time.
replacement: A coarse campaign that moves each voter group's standing by the campaign's spending and reach, as counted groups are read, so the aggregate effect of a campaign remains.
